descriptions.leads: How to manage leads in the CRM. General lead management, enquiries, sales pipeline and the leads list.
descriptions.bulk_upload: Import active leads into the Leads module. This is separate from raw prospect datasets in the Data Management module.
descriptions.add_lead: Show how to add one new enquiry; collect required details and request confirmation before creating a lead.
descriptions.global_config: Global Config: tenant-wide masters and settings such as lead statuses, sources, custom fields and reasons.
descriptions.data: Data Management: bulk prospect data import, mapping, segmentation and assignment, separate from active leads.
descriptions.attendance: Attendance: clock in/clock out and team attendance visibility.
descriptions.team: Users & Teams: users, teams, hierarchy, roles and permissions.
descriptions.org_profile: Org Profile: organisation name, contact details, logo and company profile.
descriptions.leadrat_ai: Leadrat AI / MCP: connecting AI clients such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to Leadrat.
